_comment: Word/phrase-level breakdown of Stardew Valley BigCraftables.xnb strings, for in-context mouse-over translation of individual pieces of a sentence (not a general Chinese-English dictionary -- glosses are chosen for how each word/phrase functions in THIS specific sentence). Each entry: "chinese" (exact source text), "english" (a natural-ish literal translation, for context), and "segments" -- an ordered array of {text, pinyin, gloss} whose "text" fields concatenate back to exactly reproduce "chinese" (validated by tools/segment-data/segtool.py).

AncientStool_Description.chinese: 有种祖母的公寓的味道。
AncientStool_Description.english: Has a smell like grandma's apartment.

AncientTable_Description.english: A table completely full of cobwebs.

Anvil_Description.chinese: 可以“重新锻造”饰品。每次使用消耗 3 块铱锭。
Anvil_Description.english: Can "re-forge" trinkets. Each use consumes 3 iridium bars.

AutoGrabber_Description.chinese: 每天早晨自动采集动物产品。必须放在鸡舍或畜棚内。
AutoGrabber_Description.english: Automatically collects animal products every morning. Must be placed inside a coop or barn.

AutoPetter_Description.chinese: Joja 公司专利技术，适用于鸡舍和畜棚。可以让动物们满足，但是无法实现亲自抚摸的所有好处。使用后仍可手动抚摸来补足。
AutoPetter_Description.english: Joja company patented technology, suitable for coops and barns. Can keep animals content, but can't achieve all the benefits of petting them in person. After use you can still pet them by hand to make up for it.

BaitMaker_Description.chinese: 放入鱼即可制造有针对性的鱼饵。
BaitMaker_Description.english: Put in a fish to make targeted bait.

BasicLog_Description.english: A decorative piece for the farm.

BeeHouse_Description.chinese: 置放在屋外，然后等着吃甜蜜的蜂蜜吧！（除了冬天）。
BeeHouse_Description.english: Place it outdoors, then wait to eat sweet honey! (Except in winter).

BigChest_Description.chinese: 容量几乎是普通箱子的两倍。
BigChest_Description.english: Its capacity is almost twice that of an ordinary chest.

BigGreenCane_Description.english: A decorative piece for the farm.

BigRedCane_Description.english: A decorative piece for the farm.

Bongo_Description.chinese: 一种声音浑厚的装饰乐器。
Bongo_Description.english: A decorative instrument with a deep sound.

Camera_Description.chinese: 装在三脚架上的旧相机。
Camera_Description.english: An old camera mounted on a tripod.

Cask_Description.chinese: 在地窖中使用以使产品变陈，如葡萄酒和奶酪。
Cask_Description.english: Use in the cellar to age products, such as wine and cheese.

CharcoalKiln_Description.chinese: 将 10 块木头转换成一块煤炭。
CharcoalKiln_Description.english: Turns 10 pieces of wood into one piece of coal.

Chest_Description.english: A place to store your items.

ChickenStatue_Description.english: A wooden statue of a hen.

CoffeeMaker_Description.chinese: 每天早上自动煮一杯新鲜的咖啡。
CoffeeMaker_Description.english: Automatically brews a cup of fresh coffee every morning.

Crystalarium_Description.chinese: 置入你的宝石，它就会被复制。
Crystalarium_Description.english: Put in your gem, and it will be copied.

CursedPKArcadeSystem_Description.chinese: 这台草原之王街机系统有哪里不对劲……
CursedPKArcadeSystem_Description.english: Something is wrong with this Prairie King arcade system...

DarkSign_Description.chinese: 在此上使用一个道具，即可改变显示的内容。道具不会被消耗掉。
DarkSign_Description.english: Use an item on it to change what it displays. The item won't be used up.

DeadTree_Description.chinese: 已经风干了很久的可怜树木。
DeadTree_Description.english: A poor tree that has long since dried out.

Deconstructor_Description.chinese: 销毁打造的物品，回收最有价值的材料。
Deconstructor_Description.english: Destroys crafted items, recovering the most valuable material.

Dehydrator_Description.chinese: 放入 5 个水果或可食用的蘑菇即可烘干。
Dehydrator_Description.english: Put in 5 pieces of fruit or edible mushrooms to dry them.

DeluxeScarecrow_Description.chinese: 阻止乌鸦攻击你的庄稼。范围很大（大约半径 16 格）。
DeluxeScarecrow_Description.english: Stops crows attacking your crops. Very large range (about 16 tiles radius).

DeluxeWormBin_Description.chinese: 定期产生高级鱼饵。里面的虫子可以自给自足。
DeluxeWormBin_Description.english: Regularly produces advanced bait. The worms inside are self-sufficient.

Door_Description.chinese: 一种使它缩回地面的隐蔽装置。
Door_Description.english: A hidden device that makes it retract into the ground.

EmptyCapsule_Description.english: Part of the glass has been smashed.

FarmComputer_Description.chinese: 可以扫描农场，显示实用的信息。
FarmComputer_Description.english: Can scan the farm and display useful information.

FeedHopper_Description.chinese: 可以轻易进入饲料筒仓。
FeedHopper_Description.english: Gives easy access to the feed silo.

FishSmoker_Description.chinese: 放入鱼和一块煤炭即可烟熏，熏鱼价格是普通的两倍。
FishSmoker_Description.english: Put in fish and a piece of coal to smoke it; smoked fish are worth twice the usual price.

Furnace_Description.chinese: 将矿石和煤炭转换为金属方块。
Furnace_Description.english: Turns ore and coal into metal bars.

GardenPot_Description.chinese: 在室内时，可种植任何季节的作物。在户外时，只能容纳季节性作物。
GardenPot_Description.english: Indoors, can grow crops of any season. Outdoors, can only hold seasonal crops.

GrandfatherClock_Description.chinese: 很古老……钟摆都生锈卡着了。
GrandfatherClock_Description.english: Very old... even the pendulum has rusted stuck.

GraveStone_Description.english: A decorative piece for the farm.

GreenCanes_Description.english: A decorative piece for the farm.

Heater_Description.chinese: 为你的动物在冬天中保暖。
Heater_Description.english: Keeps your animals warm in winter.

HeavyFurnace_Description.chinese: 比普通熔炉效率更高。每次使用需要 25 个矿石和 3 块煤炭。
HeavyFurnace_Description.english: More efficient than an ordinary furnace. Each use needs 25 ore and 3 pieces of coal.

HeavyTapper_Description.chinese: 放在枫树、橡树、松树上，然后等着装满树液吧！比普通树液采集器快一倍。
HeavyTapper_Description.english: Put it on a maple, oak or pine tree, then wait for it to fill with sap! Twice as fast as an ordinary tapper.

Hopper_Description.chinese: 把东西放进去，会自动加进前面的机器里。
Hopper_Description.english: Put things in, and they are automatically fed into the machine in front.

HousePlant_Description.chinese: 为你的房子或农场添加一些角色。
HousePlant_Description.english: Adds some character to your house or farm.

Incubator_Description.chinese: 将蛋孵化为小鸡和小鸭。
Incubator_Description.english: Hatches eggs into chicks and ducklings.

IronLamppost_Description.english: Provides quite a lot of light.

JunimoChest_Description.chinese: 通过森林魔法的力量，每个祝尼魔箱都连接到同一个储存处。
JunimoChest_Description.english: Through the power of forest magic, every Junimo chest connects to the same storage place.

Keg_Description.chinese: 置放水果或蔬菜在内。最终会变成饮品。
Keg_Description.english: Put fruit or vegetables inside. In the end they turn into a drink.

LawnFlamingo_Description.english: A decorative piece for the farm.

LightningRod_Description.chinese: 收集暴风雨的能量，转换为电池。
LightningRod_Description.english: Collects the energy of thunderstorms and converts it into batteries.

LockedDoor_Description.chinese: 一种使它缩回地面的隐蔽装置。
LockedDoor_Description.english: A hidden device that makes it retract into the ground.

LogSection_Description.english: A decorative piece for the farm.

Loom_Description.chinese: 将动物毛转换成美丽的布料。
Loom_Description.english: Turns animal hair into beautiful cloth.

MiniForge_Description.chinese: 你可以在家中方便地使用矮人锻造台了。
MiniForge_Description.english: You can conveniently use a dwarf forge at home now.

MiniFridge_Description.chinese: 可以储存额外的烹饪原材料。

MiniJukebox_Description.chinese: 可以播放自己最喜欢的音乐。
MiniJukebox_Description.english: Can play your own favorite music.

MiniObelisk_Description.chinese: 在农场中放置两个，就可以在它们之间传送。
MiniObelisk_Description.english: Place two on the farm, and you can teleport between them.

MiniShippingBin_Description.chinese: 放在里面的物品会在每晚售出。
MiniShippingBin_Description.english: Items put inside will be sold every night.

MixedCane_Description.english: A decorative piece for the farm.

MushroomBox_Description.chinese: 每过几天就会长出蘑菇。
MushroomBox_Description.english: Mushrooms will grow every few days.

MushroomLog_Description.chinese: 偶尔会长蘑菇。附近野树越多，效果越好。
MushroomLog_Description.english: Occasionally grows mushrooms. The more wild trees nearby, the better it works.

Obelisk_Description.chinese: 一个散发着邪恶能量的可怕传送阵。
Obelisk_Description.english: A frightening teleport array giving off evil energy.

ObsidianVase_Description.chinese: 一个由黑曜石和黄金打造的美丽装饰花瓶。
ObsidianVase_Description.english: A beautiful decorative vase made of obsidian and gold.

OrnamentalHayBale_Description.english: A decorative piece for the farm.

OstrichIncubator_Description.chinese: 将鸵鸟蛋孵化成鸵鸟雏鸟。放置在畜棚里。
OstrichIncubator_Description.english: Hatches ostrich eggs into ostrich chicks. Place in a barn.

PlushBunny_Description.english: Very big, very soft, very cute.

PrairieKingArcadeSystem_Description.chinese: 在家里玩“草原之王的冒险之旅”！
PrairieKingArcadeSystem_Description.english: Play "Journey of the Prairie King" at home!

PreservesJar_Description.chinese: 将蔬菜转换成泡菜，水果为果酱。
PreservesJar_Description.english: Turns vegetables into pickles, fruit into jam.

RecyclingMachine_Description.chinese: 将捕鱼废料转换为资源。

RedCanes_Description.english: A decorative piece for the farm.

Scarecrow_Description.chinese: 防止乌鸦袭击你的农作物。范围有限（大约半径 8 格）。
Scarecrow_Description.english: Stops crows attacking your crops. Limited range (about 8 tiles radius).

SeasonalDecor_Description.english: This decoration changes with the season.

SeasonalPlant_Description.chinese: 随着季节变化的观赏性植物。不需要浇水。
SeasonalPlant_Description.english: An ornamental plant that changes with the seasons. Doesn't need watering.

SeedMaker_Description.chinese: 将作物放入，将会产出各种各样的种子。对果树类的作物无效。
SeedMaker_Description.english: Put crops in and it will produce all kinds of seeds. Doesn't work on fruit-tree crops.

SewingMachine_Description.chinese: 用来在家中方便地量身定做衣服！
SewingMachine_Description.english: For conveniently tailoring clothes at home!

SignOfTheVessel_Description.english: A decorative piece for the farm.

SingingStone_Description.english: Gives out a pure tone when struck.

SlimeEggPress_Description.chinese: 将 100 团史莱姆泥压成一个史莱姆蛋。简直是奇迹！
SlimeEggPress_Description.english: Presses 100 lumps of slime into one slime egg. Simply a miracle!

SlimeIncubator_Description.chinese: 将史莱姆蛋孵化成史莱姆。让你能够在室外饲养史莱姆。
SlimeIncubator_Description.english: Hatches slime eggs into slimes. Lets you raise slimes outdoors.

SlothSkeletonL_Description.chinese: 这种已经灭绝的树懒曾经生活在星露谷的史前森林中。它强大的上下顎可以咬断最坚硬的植物纤维。
SlothSkeletonL_Description.english: This extinct sloth once lived in the prehistoric forests of Stardew Valley. Its powerful upper and lower jaws could bite through the hardest plant fibers.

SlothSkeletonM_Description.english: The ribs of a prehistoric sloth.

SlothSkeletonR_Description.chinese: 史前树懒的后腿和尾巴。
SlothSkeletonR_Description.english: The hind legs and tail of a prehistoric sloth.

SolarPanel_Description.chinese: 放在阳光下会缓慢地生产出电池。
SolarPanel_Description.english: Placed in sunlight, it slowly produces batteries.

Staircase_Description.english: Go to the next level of the mine.

StandingGeode_Description.chinese: 一块巨大的晶洞镶嵌在一个基座上。成千上百的紫色水晶在其中闪闪发光。
StandingGeode_Description.english: A huge geode set on a base. Hundreds of purple crystals glitter in it.

StardewHeroTrophy_Description.chinese: 星露谷居民的至高奖项！
StardewHeroTrophy_Description.english: The highest award for a Stardew Valley resident!

StatueOfBlessings_Description.chinese: 每天触摸雕像可以获得随机祝福。
StatueOfBlessings_Description.english: Touching the statue every day gets you a random blessing.

StatueOfEndlessFortune_Description.chinese: 黄金打造的。干什么用的呢？
StatueOfEndlessFortune_Description.english: Made of gold. What's it for?

StatueOfTheDwarfKing_Description.chinese: 每天二选一获得采矿能力。
StatueOfTheDwarfKing_Description.english: Each day, choose one of two to get a mining ability.

StoneCairn_Description.english: A decorative piece for the farm.

StoneFrog_Description.english: Garden art suited to the farm.

StoneJunimo_Description.english: Garden art suited to the farm.

StoneOwl_Decorative_Description.english: Garden art suited to the farm.

StoneOwl_Secret_Description.chinese: 不知道从哪儿来，但是挺耐看。
StoneOwl_Secret_Description.english: No idea where it came from, but it's quite pleasing to look at.

StoneParrot_Description.english: Garden art suited to the farm.

StoneSign_Description.chinese: 在此上使用一个道具，即可改变显示的内容。道具不会被消耗掉。
StoneSign_Description.english: Use an item on it to change what it displays. The item won't be used up.

StrangeCapsule_Description.chinese: 里面的液体有点不对劲……
StrangeCapsule_Description.english: The liquid inside is a bit off...

SuitOfArmor_Description.english: A decorative piece for the farm.

TablePieceL_Description.english: The left corner of a big table.

TablePieceR_Description.english: The right corner of a big table.

TallTorch_Description.english: The torch is made of bamboo.

Tapper_Description.chinese: 放在枫树、橡树、松树上，然后等着装满树液吧！
Tapper_Description.english: Put it on a maple, oak or pine tree, then wait for it to fill with sap!

TeddyTimer_Description.chinese: 祖父的一个泰迪熊型状闹钟。

Telephone_Description.chinese: 可以用来了解商店的营业时间和库存。
Telephone_Description.english: Can be used to find out shops' opening hours and stock.

TextSign_Description.chinese: 你可以在这个标牌上写一条信息。
TextSign_Description.english: You can write a message on this sign.

TuboFlowers_Description.chinese: 种植在橡木桶里的花朵。春天和夏天开花。
TuboFlowers_Description.english: Flowers planted in an oak barrel. Blooms in spring and summer.

WickedStatue_Description.chinese: 这个雕像看上去有点瘆人。
WickedStatue_Description.english: This statue looks a bit creepy.

WickedStatue_LitEyes_Description.chinese: 这个雕像有点不太对劲。
WickedStatue_LitEyes_Description.english: There's something not quite right with this statue.

WoodChair_Description.chinese: 一种可面朝四个方向的椅子。
WoodChair_Description.english: A chair that can face four directions.

WoodChipper_Description.chinese: 放入一块硬木，把它分解成普通的木头。
WoodChipper_Description.english: Put in a piece of hardwood to break it down into ordinary wood.

WoodLamppost_Description.english: Provides quite a lot of light.

WoodSign_Description.chinese: 在此上使用一个道具，即可改变显示的内容。道具不会被消耗掉。
WoodSign_Description.english: Use an item on it to change what it displays. The item won't be used up.

Workbench_Description.chinese: 在这里制作物品时，你可以使用任何相邻箱子中的材料。
Workbench_Description.english: When crafting items here, you can use materials in any adjacent chest.

WormBin_Description.chinese: 稳定地提供诱饵。这些虫可以依靠自身维持生存。
WormBin_Description.english: Steadily provides bait. These worms can keep themselves alive on their own.
